topics.label: Welcome and Lecture Framing
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture topic, reviews foundational cancer biology concepts, and sets the learning objectives regarding cancer evolution and the microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the stepwise acquisition of genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confers competitive growth advantages during Darwinian clonal selection.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Cancer Stem Cell Models
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how stemness properties, cellular hierarchies, and the specific cell of origin contribute to tumor initiation and propagation across different cancer types.

topics.label: Microenvironmental Interactions, Profiling, and Coevolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how inflammatory and stromal microenvironments promote and sustain tumor growth, how these cellular interactions are profiled spatially, and how coevolution drives malignancy.

topics.label: Closing Remarks and Next Lecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the concluding remarks for the session and previews the subsequent lecture on cancer therapy.
